verdict.rationale: Railway is a cloud platform, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence never mentions a downloadable OpenAPI, GraphQL schema or equivalent, and probes of the common OpenAPI paths all returned 404. The llms.txt file, the CLI and the MCP server are related agent-facing features, not an API specification, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
